## Bannerlord CPU Optimizer v0.4.1

This release removes manual fast-forward timing from benchmark and focused-profile startup.

### Stable measurement start

- Loading a benchmark save now arms the measurement instead of starting counters immediately.
- An in-game message asks the user to select maximum campaign speed.
- Measurement starts only after a supported maximum fast-forward mode remains active continuously for 1.5 real seconds.
- Campaign time-control locks, missions, pauses, and any loss of maximum speed reset the pre-start stability timer.
- Load time, the manual speed-selection delay, and the initial stabilization window are excluded from process CPU, wall-time, application-tick, GC, memory, and campaign-hour measurements.
- Career-choice, map-visibility, fixed-race, weekly-companion, benchmark, and profiler counters are reset together at the exact start boundary.

### Reporting and comparison

- JSON and CSV reports now record the start condition, time-control mode, and stability duration.
- Added application ticks per campaign hour.
- Added process CPU and wall milliseconds per application tick.
- The comparison utility now refuses mismatched start modes, missing stable-start metadata, different stability intervals, or application-tick workloads that differ by more than 5% per campaign hour.

### Preserved behavior

- The 200-campaign-hour automatic completion target is unchanged.
- Baseline still disables every released optimization.
- Optimized still enables every released safe optimization.
- Focused Profiler still starts its profiler and diagnostic benchmark together.
- No campaign speed, simulation cadence, AI, popup, menu, save data, or gameplay state is modified by the start gate.
